snippet.title: Smash Remix +EXTRA | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The release trailer for Smash Remix +EXTRA ! New characters unveiled, new stages created, and new ways to add in your own Smash 64 mods!
(And yes, we added Tap Jump.)
Please download the mod here:
https://github.com/joaorb64/smashremix-plus-extra/releases/latest

NOTE: This mod is NOT an official Smash Remix update, it builds off Remix, and adds cool stuff from the community.

If you have any questions, read the FAQ here: https://github.com/joaorb64/smashremix-plus-extra

Special thanks to OniFox for creating this wonderful trailer!
Thank you Krix for the special thumbnail!

If you enjoy videos like this, please do Subscribe, and like the video!
